title: senna alexandrina var. obtusata
intro: Senna alexandrina var. obtusata, commonly known as Alexandrian senna, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae, and is traditionally used as a laxative due to its purgative properties. The health benefits of Alexandrian senna include its ability to relieve constipation, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which stimulate bowel movements and facilitate the elimination of waste. The bioactive constituents of Alexandrian senna include sennosides A and B, which are responsible for its laxative effects and have been used to treat various gastrointestinal disorders.
